narr: The largest severe weather event of summer 2022 affected much of Middle Tennessee during the afternoon and evening hours on July 12, with numerous severe thunderstorms producing large hail and wind damage. Up to softball size hail was reported in the Chapel Hill area of Marshall County, which is the largest hail reported in Middle Tennessee in many years.
ev: A few roads were closed in Rover due to high water, including Cedar Grove Road.
Highway 129 was flooded and impassable east of Lynnville.
Facebook report indicated major road flooding occurred on Bear Creek Road.
A car stalled in high water with three people trapped inside on Mount Ararat Road. Flood waters also reached 1 to 1.5 feet deep on Weakley Creek Road.
